programs.name: same_phase_analog
programs.description: Use for hourly nonnegative series with a recurring daily cycle but unstable day-to-day shape; it replaces fixed recent-cycle blending with rolling-selected nearest historical trajectories and a robust seasonal fallback.
programs.assumption: Across the three available 24-point rolling holdouts, a same-phase analog selected from 6-, 12-, or 24-point contexts and blended with a three-cycle phase median reduces the objective 0.7*median_fold_SMAPE+0.3*max_fold_SMAPE below the parent's corresponding objective; this is falsified directly if it does not.
programs.failure_condition: It fails when fewer than four complete daily cycles are available, no historical same-phase context resembles the current context, or an unprecedented level or shape change makes all retrieved trajectories irrelevant.
